title: Backpack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body of backpack -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='56' height='52' rx='12' fill='#e2573b'/>
  <!-- lighter shade top curve -->
  <path d='M22 42 Q22 30 34 30 L66 30 Q78 30 78 42 L78 44 Q60 34 22 44 Z' fill='#ff7a5c'/>
  <!-- front pocket -->
  <rect x='32' y='58' width='36' height='20' rx='6' fill='#f9a03f'/>
  <rect x='32' y='58' width='36' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffc078'/>
  <!-- pocket zipper line -->
  <rect x='34' y='66' width='32' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a8451f'/>
  <!-- main zipper -->
  <path d='M26 40 Q50 32 74 40' stroke='#7a2e16' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zipper pull -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- top handle loop -->
  <path d='M42 28 Q50 16 58 28' stroke='#7a2e16' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shoulder straps -->
  <path d='M28 44 Q14 60 26 78' stroke='#a8451f' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 44 Q86 60 74 78' stroke='#a8451f' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- side buckle accents -->
  <rect x='19' y='56' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='75' y='56' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
